verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS payments and business-banking platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers choosing the region where data is stored. The references to accounts in 160+ countries and 40+ currencies concern where customers and payments can be served, not data storage location, so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
